name: mia-keyphrase-2b
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (low-rank adapters r=32 on 186 linear layers of the text backbone, merged into the weights)
input: a passage of up to 500 Chinese characters
output: JSON: up to 10 keyphrases copied verbatim from the passage, most important first
training_data: 3,796 passages labelled by an LLM (200 more held out for dev); not distributed
throughput: about 17 passages/s on RTX 4090, bf16, batch 16, transformers generate
